purpose: Define the explicit registry of installed packages/modules/resources, their physical source, canonical identity/version, integrity evidence and lifecycle state.

topics.name: Installed Artifact Registry
topics.purpose: Define the explicit registry of installed packages/modules/resources, their physical source, canonical identity/version, integrity evidence and lifecycle state.

semantics.identity_rule: Installed-artifact identity and canonical module/resource identity remain distinct.
semantics.integrity_rule: Applicable hash/signature/certification evidence is referenced explicitly.
semantics.remove_rule: Removal changes install state and physical bindings without silently deleting independent canonical history/evidence.
semantics.authority_rule: Registry presence does not grant invocation/access rights.

invariants.rule: Library discovery and installation are explicit source/package lifecycle semantics; filesystem presence, discovery order or installation never silently changes canonical identity, enables dependencies or activates runtime effects.

hard_gates.condition: installed registry conflates module and package identity

references.purpose: Installed artifacts may retain package integrity/certification refs.
